title: "Like a praying mantis-type insect": UFO expert breaks down four types of aliens following government disclosure
excerpt: UFO expert and astrophysicist Dr. Eric Davis opened up about four types of aliens after he said those records remain classified and are not subject to the Freedom of Information Act.
content:
Rajarshi Deb

Updated Sat, November 7, 2026 at 11:56 AM UTC

UFO expert and astrophysicist Dr. Eric Davis opened up about four types of aliens after he said those records remain classified and are not subject to the Freedom of Information Act. According to News Nation, the astrophysicist disclosed,

"There's a minimum of four that we know of. And I've seen the evidence, and I've seen the records."

The four types which Dr. Eric mentioned were Greys, Nordics, Insectoids (or Mantis-type beings), and Reptilians. The astrophysicist said,

"There's the beings that resemble or look like insects, like a praying mantis-type insect, but they're not an insect."

The UFO expert explained that some of these beings may actually be insect-like, but there was no clear evidence to confirm that. He said that when people encounter something completely unfamiliar and shocking, they often compare it to things they already know to make sense of what they were seeing. As a result, some reported species were described as insectoid beings because their appearance looked like insects, even though their true nature remained unknown.

Continue reading more about the story.

UFO update: Dr. Eric Davis opened up about four types of aliens following government disclosure

Dr. Eric Davis mentioned that at least four types of beings had been described in the records he reviewed. He revealed that he had personally seen the evidence and related documents. According to him, one group was known as the Greys, which he compared to the beings shown in the final scene of Close Encounters of the Third Kind. Dr. Eric stated,

"They variously are described as the Greys, like what everybody saw in Close Encounters of the Third Kind at the end of that movie in the final scene."

Then, the UFO expert mentioned the second type, Nordics, and he described them as very tall, human-like individuals with Caucasian features. He further listed the third type, Insectoids, and revealed that they resemble praying mantises or other insects. However, according to the astrophysicist, it remained unclear whether they were actually insect-like.

The astrophysicist then described the fourth type, Reptilians, and said that their body structure appeared similar to that of reptiles. He said,

"There's the reptilians for the same case, in that their morphology, body structure looks like a reptilian. And they may not be reptilian."

When he was asked about where the government kept these recovered alien dead bodies, he said he didn't know.

Where, according to the UFO expert, were the alien bodies kept?

According to Dr. Eric, the recovered bodies were not handed to a private organisation but to a military-linked medical institution. The astrophysicist revealed,

"Given to a military institute, a medical institute, and it's classified. And that institute has been in existence since the Civil War."

Dr. Eric further claimed that the institute was later split into two or three separate components and relocated to different military medical facilities during the first Obama administration. However, he didn't name the institute and said the original organization no longer exists in its previous form.
